summary: Runway’s Free plan grants 125 one-time credits that do not expire and do not renew monthly. They can be used with a selection of generative creative models to test concepts; do not assume all paid-plan models are available. The Free plan also includes 5GB asset storage. Upgrade if more included credits or model access is needed; no recurring promotional refresh is promised.
claim_steps: Create a free account at runwayml.com.
Receive the one-time 125-credit grant on signup.
Use the Free plan’s available selection of creative models, spending credits per run; the 125 credits do not expire or renew monthly.
Upgrade to Standard when the one-time credits run out.
